entities.name: Query protein 557 aa
observations: Sequence length is 557 aa; estimated molecular weight 62.37 kDa and theoretical pI 5.89.
Pfam detects CTP_synth_N (PF06418.21; residues 6–269) and GATase (PF00117.35; residues 306–530).
Strong homology to reviewed CTP synthases: 57.1–61.5% identity over 94.8–95.7% query coverage, with E-values 1.05e-229 to 5.43e-241.

entities.name: CTP synthase
observations: Curated homolog annotations assign EC 6.3.4.2 and describe ATP-dependent amination of UTP to CTP using L-glutamine or ammonia as nitrogen source.

The enzyme is a glutamine amidotransferase/ amidoligase fusion: the N-terminal amidoligase domain activates UTP with ATP, while the C-terminal class-I glutamine amidotransferase domain hydrolyzes glutamine.
Curated homologs are homotetramers and participate in de novo pyrimidine/CTP biosynthesis.
Reported regulation in homologs: GTP activates the glutamine-dependent reaction; CTP inhibits allosterically.

entities.name: UTP + glutamine + ATP → CTP
observations: Candidate overall reaction: UTP + L-glutamine + ATP + H2O → CTP + L-glutamate + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+), mapped to RHEA:26426 in curated homologs.
Alternative ammonia-dependent reaction: UTP + NH4(+) + ATP → CTP + ADP + phosphate + 2 H(+), mapped to RHEA:16597.
The glutaminase half-reaction is L-glutamine + H2O → L-glutamate + NH4(+), mapped to RHEA:15889.

entities.name: De novo CTP biosynthesis
observations: CTP synthase catalyzes the second and final step of de novo CTP biosynthesis from UTP in pyrimidine metabolism.
